targets: test-repo/parcelpost PR #3 (bulk: 13 planted issues that need cross-file context, 3 traps)
result: The subtle tier did not separate the arms. Both pr-review versions found all 13 planted issues in both samples, with 0 trap hits and 0 review-comment reads; the matches were checked by hand (the two F5 trap candidates are the phrase 'leaks 2 labels', not the trap claim). The native /code-review again found every implementation bug (7 of 7) at about a fifth of the cost; it missed the description mismatch and the weak rollback test in both samples, and two architectural findings in one sample. Conclusion: at +150 lines in a 15-file repo the reviewer reads every relevant file, so cross-file subtlety is not hard for this model. Difficulty has to come from scale (a PR whose callers and precedents do not fit in one read, such as a PR into test-repo/bazaar) or from domain rules that are not written in the repo.
known_limitations: Recall is still saturated for pr-review, so this tier cannot grade a skill edit either.
